The House Behind the Bottles

Pak Foods and Beverages

We craft two ranges under one roof: Tropina, our nectar and fruit drink line made with real fruit pulp and no artificial flavors, and Aqua Sina, our spring water bottled from the finest mountain sources.

Every bottle that leaves our Islamabad facility is made to the same standard — real ingredients, careful sourcing, and a taste worth reaching for again.
